# Website fonts

Lato by Łukasz Dziedzic and Poppins by the Poppins Project Authors are distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. See `Lato-OFL.txt` and `Poppins-OFL.txt` beside this file.

Source files, downloaded 2026-11-02:

- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/lato
- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/poppins

The original full TTF fonts were converted to WOFF2 with FontTools without subsetting or editing glyphs, family names, or licensing metadata. Every source character mapping is preserved. The full Lato fonts include Vietnamese uppercase and lowercase letters with all tone marks; the small Latin subsets served by Google Fonts CSS omit some of these characters.

Use Lato for Vietnamese text, including headings and controls. Poppins is used only for English display text because it does not contain all Vietnamese letters.

| File | Style | Weight |
| --- | --- | --- |
| lato-regular.woff2 | normal | 400 |
| lato-bold.woff2 | normal | 700 |
| lato-black.woff2 | normal | 900 |
| lato-italic.woff2 | italic | 400 |
| poppins-extrabold.woff2 | normal | 800 |
| poppins-extrabold-italic.woff2 | italic | 800 |
